meta.name: Find Words
meta.tag: Search the grid for hidden words

hub.tagline: Drag across letters to spell out every word on the list — words can run left-to-right, top-to-bottom, or diagonally, and at higher levels, backwards too.

all.title: Drag across letters to select a word
all.desc: Press on a letter and drag in a straight line to the word's last letter. Your selection follows a bubble of color so it stays easy to see.

all.title: Each word you find keeps its own color
all.desc: Find a word from the list and it locks in place with its own distinct color, so every found word stays clearly visible on the board.

all.title: Cross off every word on the list to win
all.desc: A found word is struck off the list at the bottom of the screen. The board is solved once every word has been found.

game.legend: drag across letters to select a word · words can read backwards too
game.winSubtitle: The whole list is crossed off — next board unlocked.
